  • Players are often assessed on individual performance during this stage
  • This phase reveals account strength and highlights areas for improvement

Key Structures

  • Hieron
  • Sanctuary

## Kingsland (Zone 7)

Kingsland represents the final and most important battlefield of KvK1.

Important Notes

  • After securing Pass 7, kingdoms cannot immediately build flags or teleport into Kingsland
  • Initial combat focuses on control of the Altar of Darkness
  • There are four Altars of Darkness available for contest

### Altar of Darkness Rules

  • Each altar opens 12 hours after the previous Chronicle is completed
  • For the remainder of KvK, altars open every 84 hours and remain open for 2 hours
  • After approximately 7–9 days, kingdoms gain the ability to build flags and engage in full territorial warfare

## Final Objective: The Ziggurat

  • The ultimate structure in KvK1 is the Great Ziggurat
  • The kingdom that controls it at the end of KvK earns a permanent star on its alliance banner
  • This marks the winning kingdom of the season

# Summary

KvK1 progresses through escalating zones of conflict:

  • Zone 4: Preparation and early objectives
  • Zone 5: Resource expansion and preparation for war
  • Zone 6: First major kingdom-scale battles
  • Zone 7 (Kingsland): Final decisive war for victory

Each phase increases in intensity and strategic importance, culminating in the final fight for the Ziggurat.

guides.title: FARM ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
guides.summary: Fuel your main account, eliminate resource bottlenecks, and master multi-account management without burning out! 🌾 The ultimate Farm Account Creation & Management Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide delivers a complete roadmap for building and running high-yield farm accounts. Learn how to rush City Hall 17 and 22 for maximum march queues, optimize civilization picks and T1 Siege production, and level core gatherers to Level 37 for peak output. Discover crucial strategies for upgrading Trading Posts to minimize transfer taxes, managing dedicated farm alliances, and avoiding anti-cheat flags—keeping your main account continuously stocked with resources for war!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- City Hall Progression Milestones: Rush your farm account's City Hall straight to CH 17 to unlock 4 march queues, and ultimately CH 22 for all 5 march queues.

- Civilization Selection: Start as France for Joan of Arc (gathering buff) and the 3% general gathering speed boost, then switch to Byzantium (10% Stone) or Rome (10% Food) based on your main's resource needs.

- T1 Siege Production: Produce T1 Siege (Battering Rams) exclusively. They are cheap, fast to build, have massive load capacities, and cost almost nothing in hospital fees if attacked on resource tiles.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Trading Post Upgrades: Maximize your Trading Post level on every farm account as early as possible. A low-level Trading Post imposes up to a 25% tax rate on transfers, wasting millions in resources.

- Account Linking Setup: Create farms on separate character slots within the same kingdom (or use secondary email/social logins) so you can run multi-instance emulators on PC for simultaneous gathering.

- Dedicated Gathering Commanders: Level core gathering commanders (Constance, Sárka, Gaius, Seondeok, Cleo, Ishida) to Level 37 to unlock the full gathering talent tree without wasting extra XP.

- Alliance Territory Gathering: Place your farm accounts in a dedicated farm alliance (or sister alliance) that controls territory with high-level resource nodes and active alliance resource pits.

- Transfer Tax Minimization: Always transfer resources via direct Trading Post transport rather than city attacks; city raiding incurs heavy troop loss, hospital costs, and potential anti-cheat flags.

- Resource Specialization: Assign specific farms to dedicated resource types (e.g., Farm 1 focuses strictly on Gold/Food, Farm 2 focuses on Wood/Stone) to maximize commander skill synergies.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Daily AP Utilization: Spend your farm's free daily Action Points on map barbarians during events to stock up inventory speedup chests and additional resource tokens.

- Courier Station Discount Buys: Check the Courier Station on your farms daily to buy resource tokens and gathering speedup items using raw, uncollected city resources.

- VIP 6 Baseline: Get your farm accounts to VIP 6 as quickly as possible using free gems from events to permanently unlock the 2nd building queue and passive gathering boosts.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Training High-Tier Combat Units: Never train T3 or T4 troops on farm accounts; they drain high amounts of food/gold in upkeep and waste speedups better used on technology upgrades.

- Rushing CH 25 Early: Do not waste valuable resources pushing a farm past City Hall 22 early on; CH 22 already provides 5 full gathering marches at a fraction of the cost.

- Transferring During Anti-Bot Flags: Avoid sending massive, rapid resource transfers on brand new accounts without daily activity, as this can trigger automated resource removal flags.

guides.title: GATHERING TALENT TREE
guides.summary: Master the ideal talent setups, optimize leveling paths, and maximize your daily resource yields across every node! 🌾 The ultimate Gathering Commander Talent Trees & Leveling Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide outlines how to build and level your gathering commanders for peak efficiency. Learn why Level 37 is the critical milestone for Superior Gathering, how Level 40 unlocks Modified Axle for maximum return speed, and how primary-only talent rules dictate your pairings. Discover zero-cost XP leveling tricks through Guardian runs, ideal secondary pairings with commanders like Constance for completion bonuses, and essential safety talents to keep your gatherers fast, safe, and productive!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Commander Level Thresholds: Level 37 is the absolute baseline for all primary gatherers to unlock Superior Gathering, which grants maximum speed across all node types. Level 40 is the endgame goal to pick up Modified Axle for maximum March Speed.

- Primary-Only Talent Rule: Only the talents on your Primary Commander are active during gathering runs. The talents of your Secondary Commander do not apply—only their skill levels boost performance.

- Troop Load vs. March Speed: Siege units possess the highest load capacity per unit in the game, making T1 Siege the most cost-effective troop choice for clearing high-level resource nodes without inflating hospital costs.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Universal Level 37 Base Build: Rush straight to the top node of the Gathering tree to max Superior Gathering (3/3). From there, fill out node-specific nodes based on your commander's natural specialization (Stone, Gold, Food, or Wood).

- Level 40 Max Efficiency Path: After hitting Level 37, spend your remaining 3 talent points directly into Modified Axle (3/3) in the Integration/Mobility tree (or leftover base gathering nodes) to increase march speed when returning to city with full loads.

- Secondary March Pairings: Pair specialized primary gatherers (e.g., Seondeok for Gold) with high-yield secondary gatherers (like Constance or Joan of Arc) to secure extra resource packs upon node completion.

- Node Clearance Bonus: Maximize The More The Merrier (3/3) in the talent tree to gain an extra 6% resource bonus delivered directly to your inventory bag upon fully clearing a resource deposit.

- March Speed Out of Nodes: Unlock Swiftness (2/2) and Hasty Departure (1/1) to grant your gathering marches massive temporary movement speed bursts when exiting resource tiles to evade enemy tile-hunters.

- Load Capacity Allocation: Take Armed to the Teeth (3/3) if gathering with non-siege marches during war zones, but rely primarily on Gathering Mastery nodes to naturally expand march carrying capacity.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Leveling Gatherers via Guardians: Never waste generic Knowledge Tomes on farm commanders past Level 20. Send your gathering commanders as secondary commanders to daily Holy Site Guardian runs to level them to 37 completely free.

- Zone 3 Node Targeting: Park your farm marches near high-tier nodes in Zone 3 or KvK maps; higher-level nodes feature larger total resource pools, keeping your gatherers operating at peak efficiency for hours.

- Kingdom & Alliance Buff Stacking: Activate a 24-Hour 80% Gathering Boost item alongside active Alliance Territory gathering buffs (+25%) before dispatching your fully-specced gatherers overnight.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Pushing Gatherers Past Level 40: Avoid spending XP to level gathering commanders to Level 60; talent points past Level 40 grant negligible utility for resource gathering and waste millions of XP better spent on combat commanders.

- Leaving Nodes Partially Cleared: Never abandon a resource node with a few thousand resources remaining. Failing to clear a node prevents new high-level nodes from spawning in your alliance territory.

- Gathering with High-Tier Combat Units: Avoid sending T4 or T5 combat troops to gather during KvK; if your tile gets attacked, repairing high-tier units drains massive amounts of gold and speedups.

guides.title: GEM GATHERING GUIDE
guides.summary: Tired of wasting precious march time every time your gatherers return home after a single gem node? 💎  Discover how to use pass-locking in Rise of Kingdoms to keep your gatherers out in Zone 2 hopping from node to node effortlessly! Learn the exact setup, march load requirements, and key commander pairings to safely maximize your daily gem yields while keeping your account safe.
guides.content_markdown:
GEM GATHERING GUIDE

CurlyGaming X RoKNUT Academy 

This guide is for all players, Early game through SOC, this method can be used for all accounts F2P to P2W.

This guide is in an SOC HK account however this works in any KVK and account that has unlocked level 2 passes in your home kingdom! 

- 
Most players send out the gathers individually, and gather 1 node at a time closest to their city with a couple of marches. 

This method works, however it is super inefficient and is using up more of your time than needed!

- 
The best method to gem farming is by locking your march outside of passes. (Shown in CurlyGaming Youtube video)

•In this method you are going to send out 1-5 marches from your city in zone 3 to each zone in zone 2. 

•make sure your marches have lots of troops able to farm up to 1,000+ gems at a time (80k+)

•When your marches arrive at the level 3 passes leave and go to each allaince controlling the pass to get your march through. 

•now make sure you do not return to an allaince controlling a level 3 pass otherwise your marches will return after the gem node is finished farming!

• if you have done the above step correctly then you will see that after finishing a gem node your march has fully stopped where the former node was. This meaning you can do a few nodes, go back to scrolling CurlyGaming YouTube shorts, log back in do some more, and not have to 24/7 grind the gem nodes and worry about them returning to your city.

Reality/gem botting:

•do not compare your gem farming, or gem farming reports to any other player, the sad reality is lots of players are now using gem bots. That is somewhat being banned by Lilith. These gem bots offer 4k gems a day for each march crazy stats. For 1 it is morally wrong and for 2 the chance of being banned for this is the highest it’s ever been.

guides.title: HONOR POINTS FARMING
guides.summary: Maxize your KvK leaderboard rankings, unlock top-tier reward milestones, and master efficient Honor Point farming! 🏆 The ultimate KvK Honor Point Farming Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide breaks down the core mechanics of accumulating personal and alliance Honor across the Lost Kingdom map. Learn how to never miss Ancient Ruins and Dark Altars schedules, maximize barbarian AoE chaining for high Honor yields at low AP costs, and deploy 5-march swarms in high-density zones. Discover crucial strategies for territory gathering, AP bottle allocation, and alliance fort rallies to push your ranking and claim exclusive city skins and legendary sculptures!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Honor Point Sources: Honor Points are accumulated through four primary activities: occupying Holy Sites (Ruins/Altars), barbarian hunting (single kills & AoE chaining), destroying Barbarian Forts, and gathering resources within the Lost Kingdom.

- Alliance vs. Individual Honor Dual-Track: Individual Honor unlocks personal reward milestones (up to 130,000+ points for City Skins and Legendary Sculptures). Alliance Honor drives your alliance’s overall rank on the KvK leaderboard for kingdom-wide buffs.

- Level Scaling: High-level barbarians (Level 36–40–45+ depending on KvK season) yield significantly more Honor Points per kill than low-level ones. Always push forward into higher zones as passes open.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Ruins and Dark Altars Priority: Ancient Ruins open every 36 hours (lasting 2 hours) and Dark Altars open every 84 hours (lasting 4 hours). Parking a march inside the capture circle yields passive Honor Points per minute—never miss a schedule window.

- Barbarian AoE Chaining: Use circular AoE commanders (like Sun Tzu, YSG, or Zhuge Liang) to pull multiple barbarians into your main target. Damaging adjacent barbarians rewards full Honor Points for 0 extra AP spent per chained target.

- 5-March Simultaneous Hunting: When active, deploy 5 Peacekeeping/AoE marches into high-density zones. Swarming a single barbarian with 5 marches rewards independent Honor rolls for each march involved.

- AP Discount Talent Utilization: Maximize the Insight talent (-10 AP cost per attack) on all primary Peacekeeping commanders to drop continuous barbarian kill costs to 30 AP per march.

- Gathering Node Honor Integration: Send gathering marches exclusively to Level 6+ resource nodes located inside alliance territory. Completely clearing a high-tier node yields bonus individual and alliance Honor upon completion.

- Action Point Bottle Allocation: Save your heavy Action Point recovery bottle stockpiles for high-level barbarian sectors (Zone 5, Zone 6, and the Lost Temple / Kingsland area) where Honor payouts per AP spent reach their peak.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Ruins Dual-March Strategy: If your alliance controls the Ancient Ruins uncontested, send two distinct marches (or assist alliance members) to occupy the circle to maximize individual Honor gains during the 2-hour window.

- Fort Rally Optimization: Coordinate 5-man mini-rallies against high-level Barbarian Forts within your alliance. Forts grant high bulk Honor Points for both individual players and overall alliance territory standing.

- Territory Flag Expansion: Ensure your alliance leadership continually flags and captures Holy Sites, Crusader Camps, and Hieron structures across the Lost Kingdom map to generate constant passive Alliance Honor over time.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- AFK During Ruins/Altars: Avoid ignoring Ruins or Altars timer calls from your alliance. Missing these scheduled events sacrifices tens of thousands of "free" passive Honor Points that cannot be easily recovered by raw barbarian grinding.

- Gathering Off-Territory: Do not gather on un-flagged neutral tiles during KvK. Off-territory gathering forfeits the +25% gathering speed buff and denies your alliance territorial Honor generation.

- Hunting Low-Level Barbarians: Avoid burning valuable AP bottles on lower-level barbarians in Zone 4 once higher-tier zones (Zone 5/6) have opened up; low-tier kills offer extremely poor Honor-to-AP conversion ratios.

guides.title: PASS-LOCKING GEM GATHERING
guides.summary: Unlock thousands of free gems daily, eliminate transit delays, and master advanced map pathing! 💎 The ultimate Pass-Locking Gem Gathering Strategy Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide reveals how to maximize your gem farming efficiency by chaining nodes sequentially without returning to your city. Learn how to leverage Pass line-of-sight and territorial chokepoints, load marches with massive T1 Siege capacity for multi-node clears, and pair gathering commanders like Constance to extract bonus gems. Discover how to avoid pathing detours around mountain ranges, maintain optimal gathering speed buffs, and keep gem nodes spawning continuously across Zone 2, Zone 3, and KvK maps!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
PASS-LOCKING GEM GATHERING STRATEGY

CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Pass Locking Definition: Pass locking is a advanced spatial pathing mechanic in Rise of Kingdoms where you route gathering marches near alliance or kingdom Passes to maintain vision, eliminate long return animations, and chain gem node gathering sequentially without returning to city.

- The No-Return Chain Rule: Returning to city between gem nodes wastes 60%–80% of your operational time in march transit. Marches must carry enough troop capacity (via T1 Siege) to clear multiple gem nodes continuously before heading home.

- Pass Line-of-Sight (LoS): Level 1, 2, and 3 Passes grant continuous vision over transit corridors. Position your main city or march routing adjacent to Passes to scan wide radiuses for newly spawned Level 1 and Level 2 gem tiles in Zone 2 and Zone 3.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Pass Routing Anchor Points: Move your city directly adjacent to a territorial Pass separating two major zones. This lets you alternate gathering between both sides of the pass without incurring long pathing delays around mountain terrain.

- Manual March Queuing (Node-to-Node): Never click "Return to City" after a node finishes. Set notifications or internal timers (approx. 10–15 minutes per Level 2 gem node) and issue a direct march command from the active gem tile straight to the next nearby node.

- Chokepoint Sweeping Routine: Patrol pass chokepoints every 15–20 minutes. Gem nodes refresh rapidly near geographical boundaries and passes due to high map activity and node turnover.

- 100% T1 Siege Allocation: Deploy T1 Battering Rams exclusively for gem chains. T1 Siege provides the highest movement speed among siege units, massive load capacity, and near-zero repair costs if caught by enemy tile hunters during KvK.

- Commander Pairings for Travel Speed: Pair primary gathering commanders with secondary movement/integration commanders (such as Gaius Marius or Ishida) to boost overall march speed between scattered gem tiles.

- Research & Buff Requirements: Maximize the Jewelry technology tree in your Academy for a +35% gem gathering speed boost, and maintain an active 24-Hour 50% Gathering Speed Buff at all times.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Constance Secondary Bonus: Always run Constance as a secondary commander on one of your main gem-farming marches. Her passive skill grants +10% additional resources upon completion, yielding +1 extra gem on Level 1 tiles and +2 extra gems on Level 2 tiles.

- Map Border Boundary Trick: Send your gatherers along mountain ranges anchored by passes. The game engine tends to cluster uncollected gem nodes along impassable mountain boundaries near pass gates.

- KvK High-Tier Node Chaining: In Lost Kingdom (KvK) maps, high-tier (Level 5–6) gem nodes yield far more gems per node. Use pass-locking around KvK Zigguarts and Zone 4 Passes to lock down 500+ gems per march cycle.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Auto-Pathing Through Enemy Passes: Never issue a node-to-node command that forces your gathering march to path through an enemy-controlled or un-passable pass; your march will take a massive detour around mountain ranges, wasting up to 20 minutes in travel.

- Under-Sizing Troop Loads: Avoid sending small troop counts that can only clear a single gem tile. Load each march with at least 15,000–20,000 T1 Siege to allow 10+ continuous node clears before needing to dump load at home.

- Leaving Partial Gem Tiles: Always clear every single gem from a node (e.g., all 10 or 20 gems). Leaving 1 or 2 gems in a node prevents the tile from despawning and stops fresh gem nodes from spawning in that pass sector.

  • 100% T1 Siege Allocation: Deploy T1 Battering Rams exclusively for gem chains. T1 Siege provides the highest movement speed among siege units, massive load capacity, and near-zero repair costs if caught by enemy tile hunters during KvK.
  • Commander Pairings for Travel Speed: Pair primary gathering commanders with secondary movement/integration commanders (such as Gaius Marius or Ishida) to boost overall march speed between scattered gem tiles.
  • Research & Buff Requirements: Maximize the Jewelry technology tree in your Academy for a +35% gem gathering speed boost, and maintain an active 24-Hour 50% Gathering Speed Buff at all times.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

  • Constance Secondary Bonus: Always run Constance as a secondary commander on one of your main gem-farming marches. Her passive skill grants +10% additional resources upon completion, yielding +1 extra gem on Level 1 tiles and +2 extra gems on Level 2 tiles.

  • Map Border Boundary Trick: Send your gatherers along mountain ranges anchored by passes. The game engine tends to cluster uncollected gem nodes along impassable mountain boundaries near pass gates.
  • KvK High-Tier Node Chaining: In Lost Kingdom (KvK) maps, high-tier (Level 5–6) gem nodes yield far more gems per node. Use pass-locking around KvK Zigguarts and Zone 4 Passes to lock down 500+ gems per march cycle.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

  • Auto-Pathing Through Enemy Passes: Never issue a node-to-node command that forces your gathering march to path through an enemy-controlled or un-passable pass; your march will take a massive detour around mountain ranges, wasting up to 20 minutes in travel.

  • Under-Sizing Troop Loads: Avoid sending small troop counts that can only clear a single gem tile. Load each march with at least 15,000–20,000 T1 Siege to allow 10+ continuous node clears before needing to dump load at home.
  • Leaving Partial Gem Tiles: Always clear every single gem from a node (e.g., all 10 or 20 gems). Leaving 1 or 2 gems in a node prevents the tile from despawning and stops fresh gem nodes from spawning in that pass sector.

guides.title: RESOURCE NODE TIER OPTIMIZATION
guides.summary: Maximize your daily resource income, minimize transit downtime, and master node mechanics across all map zones! 🌾 The ultimate High-Level vs Low-Level Node Gathering Efficiency Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide breaks down the underlying math behind node selection and gathering speeds. Learn how to optimize your AFK sleep schedule with Level 7 & 8 nodes, accelerate active play sessions with high-turnover Level 5 & 6 nodes, and maximize completion traits with commanders like Constance. Discover crucial habits for leveraging alliance territory speed buffs, utilizing Alliance Pits, and avoiding partial node clears to keep high-value resource nodes spawning continuously!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Base Gathering Rate: The raw gathering speed (resources collected per second) is identical across all node levels (Level 1 through Level 8) for the same resource type.

- Travel and Transit Overhead: Gathering efficiency drops whenever a march is in motion. Frequent short trips to lower-tier nodes incur significantly higher total transit overhead than fewer long-duration trips to high-tier nodes.

- The "More Than Merrier" Factor: Fully clearing a node triggers talent bonuses (such as The More The Merrier, granting +6% bonus resources directly to your inventory). Higher-tier nodes amplify this bonus by delivering a larger total resource payout upon completion.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- AFK / Sleep Routine (Level 7 & 8 Nodes): Deploy your 5 gathering marches to Level 7 (Zone 3) or Level 8 (KvK Zone 4 / Crystal Age) nodes right before going offline for 6+ hours. The higher node capacity prevents your gatherers from idling while you sleep.

- Active Gameplay Routine (Level 5 & 6 Nodes): When actively managing your account every 1–2 hours, prioritize Level 5 and Level 6 nodes located within 10–15 tiles of your city. Rapid clear rates trigger completion bonuses more frequently per day.

- Constance Secondary Maximization: Always attach Constance as a secondary commander to your highest-tier node march (Level 7/8 Gold or Gem nodes) to maximize her +10% completion reward on the largest base resource pool available.

- The Transit Time Penalty Math:

   * Level 5 Node (~500k RSS): ~1.5 hours gather time + 2 min round-trip transit = 2.2% time wasted in transit.
   * Level 8 Node (~5.0M RSS): ~10 hours gather time + 2 min round-trip transit = 0.3% time wasted in transit.

- Node Clearing Etiquette: Always clear nodes to 100% completion. Leaving a partially harvested node blocks the game map from spawning a fresh high-level replacement node in that sector.

- Alliance Territory Node Multiplier: Gathering inside friendly alliance territory provides a passive +25% gathering speed buff. Always prioritize Level 6/7/8 nodes touching your alliance flags over unflagged neutral nodes.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Alliance Resource Pit Priority: Treat the Alliance Resource Center (Pit) as a "Level 99 Node." It holds up to 30M+ resources, grants alliance territory buffs, cannot be tile-hit, and provides zero idle downtime overnight.

- KvK Zone 4 Gem Nodes (Level 5–6): In Lost Kingdom maps, Level 5 and Level 6 Gem nodes yield 50 to 60 gems each. Pair primary gatherers with fast movement commanders to chain gem tiles sequentially without returning to city.

- Tile Search Range Limit: Keep gathering march travel times under 60 seconds one-way. If reaching a Level 8 node requires a 4-minute march across enemy territory, a nearby Level 6 node delivers better net resource-per-hour efficiency.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Farming Level 8 Nodes When Active: Avoid locking all 5 marches onto distant Level 8 nodes if you plan to log in every hour; you forfeit frequent node-completion bonuses and leave marches unresponsive during surprise KvK rallies.

- Gathering Off-Territory During KvK: Do not send gatherers to high-tier nodes outside alliance territory boundaries unless necessary; off-territory nodes lose the 25% territory speed buff and leave marches vulnerable to enemy tile-hunters.

- Abandoning Partially Cleared Nodes: Never leave 10,000 resources remaining in a Level 7 or 8 node. Doing so wastes your talent completion bonuses and denies your kingdom new node spawns.

guides.title: TILE HIT DEFENSE & ETIQUETTE
guides.summary: Protect your gathering marches, safeguard your resources, and avoid costly hospital bills during KvK! 🛡️ The ultimate Tile Hitting & Anti-Tile Hitting Survival Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide breaks down essential safety protocols for open-map gathering in contested zones. Learn why T1 Siege is non-negotiable, how to leverage Alliance Pits and territory buffs for zero-risk farming, and how to master quick recall micro-management to deny enemies easy Kill Points. Discover tactical tricks like the Bait-and-Switch counter to trap enemy rogue hunters, avoid critical diplomatic blunders, and keep your hospital clean while farming safely!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Tile Hit Definition: Attacking an enemy's gathering march while it is actively collecting resources on a map tile. In KvK, enemy players look for exposed gatherers to earn cheap Kill Points (KP) without risking high wounded counts.

- Strict T1 Siege Rule: Always send T1 Siege (Battering Rams) for open-map gathering. T1 Siege carries high load capacity, moves fast, and costs virtually zero gold or speedups to instantly heal if hit.

- Hospital Fill Safeguard: If an enemy tile-hits your gatherers while your hospital is already full from open-field combat, your gathering troops will die permanently. Always heal your hospital before sending out farms.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Alliance Territory Anchoring: Gather strictly on resource nodes located inside active alliance territory flags or alliance resource pits. Friendly territory provides gathering speed bonuses and acts as a deterrent against enemy roamers.

- Safe Zone vs. War Zone Farming: Never send gathering marches into contested zones (Zone 4 or active frontlines) while offline. Keep AFK farming strictly in rear safe zones protected by locked passes.

- Recall Micro-Management: Set timers based on node clear times. If an enemy march paths toward your tile, hit Recall immediately—reclaiming troops before impact wastes the enemy's travel time and yields them zero KP.

- Zero T4/T5 on Tiles: Never deploy T4 or T5 combat troops to gather resources. If a combat march gets tile-hit, your hospital bill will drain millions in resources and days of speedups.

- Movement Speed Talents: Maximize nodes like Swiftness and Hasty Departure in the Gathering tree. These grant massive movement speed bursts when exiting tiles, letting gatherers sprint safely to nearby friendly cities.

- Peace Shielding Away-Marches: If you must park your city in an unsafe forward zone, ensure a 8-Hour or 24-Hour Peace Shield is active so enemies cannot follow your gatherers home to raid your city.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- The Bait-and-Switch Counter: If an enemy repeatedly targets your gatherers, send a high-tier combat march (like a fully geared tank/AoE march) onto a resource tile hidden under a gathering commander skin to wipe out incoming enemy cavalry tile-hunters.

- Alliance Pit Priority: Rely heavily on the Alliance Resource Center (Pit) for overnight or long-duration gathering. Pits hold tens of millions of resources, cannot be tile-hit by enemies, and offer completely safe gathering.

- Scout Sweep Protocol: Perform a quick map sweep before deploying gathering marches. If enemy rogue players or cavalry marches are roaming your territory, clear them out before sending gatherers.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Tile Hitting Allies or Neutrals: Never tile-hit players from allied or neutral kingdoms during KvK unless your kingdom leadership has officially declared an all-out Kill Event (KE). Unsanctioned tile-hitting breaches kingdom etiquette and triggers diplomatic backlash.

- Leaving Partial Tiles Exposed: Always fully clear resource nodes. Leaving a node partially cleared blocks new high-level nodes from spawning and invites enemies to clear the remainder on your territory.

- Gathering Unshielded Near Enemy Passes: Do not gather within 20–30 tiles of an enemy-controlled Pass or territory border without actively watching the screen; high-speed enemy cavalry can reach your tile in under 15 seconds.

guides.title: F2P KVK SURVIVAL
guides.summary: Master your trade efficiency, survive heavy engagements, and rack up massive Kill Points without bankrupting your account! 🛡️ The ultimate F2P KvK Survival Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide delivers essential tactical rules for budget players stepping into the Kingdom vs. Kingdom warzone. Master the strict Single March Rule to preserve hospital space, use the 15-Minute Alliance Help batch-healing trick to heal for free, and leverage Pre-KvK Marauders for massive AP dumping. Discover how to safely trade KP by staying inside the murderball, filling whale-led rallies/garrisons, and farming Honor Points through barbarian chaining and Ruins scheduling—all while keeping your city safe from getting zeroed!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
F2P KVK SURVIVAL GUIDE

CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Single March Rule: Deploy only one high-quality primary march into open-field KvK battles. Bringing 2 to 3 half-baked marches splits your stats, doubles your hospital bill, and causes you to lose trades exponentially faster.

- Hospital Capacity Monitoring: Keep an eye on your Hospital capacity before joining any skirmish. Once your hospital hits maximum capacity, any additional severely wounded troops suffer permanent death.

- Commanders for Positive Trades: Run high-survivability or high-AoE pairings (such as Sun Tzu/Aethelflaed for early KvK or Scipio/Liu Che for late game) to gain high Kill Points (KP) through area damage while staying tanky.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Barbarian AoE Chaining: Use commanders with circular AoE active skills (like Sun Tzu or YSG) to pull multiple barbarians simultaneously. Spending AP to attack 1 barbarian while hitting 3 to 4 adjacent ones generates massive Honor Points at near-zero AP cost.

- Ruins and Altars Schedule: Set alarms for standard Ancient Ruins and Dark Altars timer unlocks. Attending these events grants massive passive Honor Points per minute simply by keeping a march parked on the capture circle.

- Rally and Garrison Duty: Avoid initiating rallies or garrisoning structures as a F2P player—your stats will bleed severely. Fill rallies and garrisons led by kingdom whales to earn reliable KP using their superior stats.

- Batch Healing (The 15-Minute Trick): Never heal your entire wounded army at once. Heal troops in small batches (e.g., 1 to 2 hours per batch) and leverage Alliance Helps to finish the timer instantly without using speedup items.

- Marauder AP Dumping: Save 100% of your stored Action Point (AP) recovery bottles for the Pre-KvK Marauder event. Dumping AP here yields hundreds of speedup days, resources, and parchment boxes to fund your entire KvK campaign.

- Farm Account Dependency: Run at least 1 or 2 resource farm accounts inside your kingdom's home zone. Feed raw resources directly to your main city to sustain massive hospital healing costs without draining speedup bags.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- The Ball-and-Chain Tactic: In open-field battles, stay tucked safely inside your kingdom's main army "murderball." Target overextended enemy units on the edges, land your burst, and instantly retreat back into your frontline.

- Node Stealing and Disruption: Hunt low-power enemy gathering marches on contested resources using fast cavalry marches to collect quick, low-risk Kill Points without taking heavy wounded counts.

- Holy Site Defense: Capture and occupy higher-tier KvK structures (such as Gates, Ziggurat, and Camps) with your alliance to passively generate territory-wide Honor Points over the course of the season.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Swarming Enemy Whales: Never open-field attack or swarm high-tier enemy whales or T5 marches solo; their counterattack damage will melt your T4 march and fill your hospital in seconds.

- Fighting Without Territory Buffs: Avoid engaging in open-field combat outside of friendly alliance territory, as you lose crucial territory defense and movement speed buffs.

- Overnight City Un-shielded: Never leave your city un-shielded near active border zones or contested passes. Getting zeroed during KvK destroys months of troop training progress instantly.

guides.title: F2P TROOP TRAINING STRATEGY
guides.summary: Build a massive, combat-ready army efficiently without draining your speedups or resources! ⚔️ The definitive F2P Troop Training Strategy Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide outlines how budget players can maximize army size, event points, and combat readiness. Learn how to rush T4 technology, leverage continuous T1 Siege training for zero-risk gathering, and use the T2/T3-to-T4 batch upgrade method during major scoring events like Mightiest Governor. Discover crucial habits for stacking runes, titles, alliance helps, and kingdom buffs to get the absolute most power out of every single speedup!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
F2P TROOP TRAINING STRATEGY GUIDE

CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Training Building Expansion: Prioritize upgrading your primary troop training structures (Barracks, Archery Range, Stable, Siege Workshop) alongside your City Hall to increase batch capacity per training cycle.

- T4 Unlock Rush: Rush military technology straight to Tier 4 (T4) units before heavily spending training speedups; training lower-tier units early yields significantly less combat power per speedup used.

- The T1 Siege Foundation: Maintain continuous, zero-speedup training of T1 Siege units (Battering Rams) throughout the early game for low-cost, high-capacity resource gathering.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Overnight Batch Optimization: Align your daily training batch sizes with your sleep schedule. Train larger batches before bed so queues operate continuously without sitting idle overnight.

- T2/T3 Upgrade Strategy: Instead of training raw T4 units from scratch during speedup events, train massive pools of T2 or T3 units passively during downtime, then upgrade them to T4 during scoring events.

- Event Synchronization: Save 100% of your dedicated Training Speedups and Universal Speedups for major scoring events like The Mightiest Governor (Stage 1) or Game of Power.

- Resource Reserve Protection: Keep resource rewards stored as tokens inside your inventory bag. Only open them when initiating training batches to protect resources from enemy city raids.

- Alliance Help Maximization: Always request and wait for full Alliance Helps before applying manual speedup items to high-tier troop training batches.

- Rune & Title Stacking: Grab a 10% Training Speed Rune and request the Duke Title (+5% Training Speed) from kingdom chat before popping massive speedup stacks.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Kingdom Buff Timing: Coordinate major troop pushes during active Kingdom Training Buffs (+10% Training Speed) activated by the King prior to KvK.

- VIP Shop Speedup Accumulation: Purchase all discounted 5-minute and 60-minute training speedups from the VIP Shop using food and wood every weekly refresh.

- Farming March Allocation: Keep all gathering marches constantly deployed on high-level map nodes to maintain a steady resource influx matching your daily training consumption.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Training T4 Siege Units: Avoid spending training speedups or heavy resources on T4 Siege units; T1 Siege carries equal gathering speed with negligible repair costs.

- Burning Universals Outside Events: Never spend generic Universal Speedups on troop training outside of structured power or training events.

- Draining Gold Reserves: Avoid over-training secondary troop types to the point where your Gold reserves drop too low to cover hospital healing bills during KvK combat.

guides.title: THE F2P GEM MANAGEMENT
guides.summary: Turn every single gem into maximum long-term account growth! 💎 The definitive F2P Gem Management Guide for Rise of Kingdoms.This guide reveals how budget players can stretch every gem by treating gems primarily as VIP Points. Learn how to systematically hit VIP 10, 12, and 14 to unlock up to 3 daily universal legendary sculptures, master the More Than Gems (MTG) 14k and 50k spending tiers, and optimize Wheel of Fortune spin thresholds. Discover smart habits for gem farming, Courier Station discounts, and Castle 25 progression while avoiding critical gem-sinks that slow down your account!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
THE F2P GEM MANAGEMENT GUIDE
CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- VIP Target Priority: The fundamental rule of F2P progression is that Gems are VIP Points. VIP unlocks permanent, compounding passive value that outlives any individual gear piece or event reward.

- The Sculpture Milestones: Target VIP 6 early (second building queue), then push directly to VIP 10 (1 daily Universal Legendary Sculpture), VIP 12 (2 daily sculptures), and ultimately VIP 14 (3 daily sculptures).

- Strict Exclusions: Never spend gems on resources, speedups from the standard shop, golden keys, speed-building low-tier structures, or un-discounted wheel spins.

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- More Than Gems (MTG) Synchronization: Never dump gems into VIP points on regular days. Wait for the bi-monthly "More Than Gems" event to turn your VIP pushes into free Universal Sculptures.

- Wheel Tier Selection: Spend gems on the Wheel of Fortune strictly to unlock core meta commanders or hit fixed milestone thresholds (10 or 45 spins); never spin randomly without a targeted chest in mind.

- Castle 25 Bottleneck Management: Save gem investments for Master's Blueprints and Books of the Covenant (for Castle 25) exclusively during MTG events, and only after hitting at least VIP 10 or VIP 12.

- MTG Spending Tiers:

   * 14,000 Gem Budget: Spend 7,000 gems on Day 1 + 7,000 gems on Day 2 (Yields 10 gold heads at 1,400 gems/sculpture).
   * 50,000 Gem Budget: Spend 25,000 gems on Day 1 + 25,000 gems on Day 2 (Yields 26 gold heads).

- Wheel Value Formula: Claim your 1 daily free spin and 3 daily half-price (400 gems) spins on every wheel. If completing a push, stop at 10 spins (5,600 gems net cost) or 45 spins (~30,800 gems net cost) for maximum ROI per gem.

- VIP Point Conversion Rate: Buying VIP directly via the VIP menu costs 1 Gem per 1 VIP Point. Buying 1,000 or 5,000 VIP point items lets you hit exact MTG milestone numbers with zero gem overflow.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Zone 3 & KvK Gem Farming: Send gathering marches to farm gem nodes in Zone 3 or KvK maps whenever off-field; dedicated gem farming yields 1,000 to 3,000+ gems daily.

- VIP 14 Rush Before T5: Do not burn hundreds of thousands of gems rushing Castle 25 for T5 troops early; reaching VIP 14 first generates 1,095 free gold heads per year.

- Courier Station Discount Checking: Check the Courier Station (Merchant) every refresh to buy discounted speedups or materials using resource tokens, but only buy 70%+ discounted items using gems if they directly help hit an event milestone.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Rushing Wheels Past 100 Spins: Avoid spinning a wheel between 101 and 183 times; the absence of milestone chests in this gap heavily degrades your sculpture-per-gem yield.

- Spending Gems Outside MTG: Purchasing VIP points or Castle books outside of MTG wastes dozens of free Universal Sculptures every few months.

- Diversifying Across Too Many Wheels: Avoid spinning wheels for off-meta or secondary troop commanders; direct 100% of your non-VIP gems toward the primary commander for your main KvK march.

guides.title: DIPLOMACY & KVK MATCHMAKING
guides.summary: Secure winnable matchups, build unbreakable alliances, and avoid getting stomped on Day 1! 🤝 The ultimate Diplomacy & KvK Matchmaking Guide for Rise of Kingdoms. This guide breaks down how matchmaking seeds are calculated from your kingdom's Top 300 power, and how to leverage diplomatic coalitions to secure winnable wars. Learn why controlling pre-snapshot power pushes protects your seed tier, how to build 2-3 kingdom coalitions to avoid getting double-teamed, and why purging inactive bloat accounts keeps your kingdom competitive. Discover essential habits for tracking rival kingdom power via scanner tools, synchronizing buffs during snapshot week, and never breaking diplomatic pacts that could trigger a gang-up!
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
⚔️ DIPLOMACY & KVK MATCHMAKING GUIDE

CORE MECHANICS & STARTER SETUP

- Top 300 Power Baseline: Matchmaking power scores are calculated directly from the combined power of a kingdom's Top 300 Governors. Lower-ranking players outside the top 300 do not impact your kingdom's official matchmaking seed.

- Snapshot Freeze Date: The system takes a hidden data snapshot of your kingdom's top 300 players approximately 1 to 2 weeks before the matchmaking phase officially begins.

- Matchmaking Seeds: Kingdoms are grouped into Seed Tiers based on their relative ranking among competing kingdoms:
      * Seed A: Top 10%–15% highest power kingdoms (Whale-heavy, massive T5 field density).
      * Seed B: Upper-middle tier (High activity, strong T4/T5 balance).
      * Seed C: Lower-middle tier (Manageable field fights, fewer megawhales).
      * Seed D: Lowest power tier (Casual kingdoms, lower field density).

STRATEGIC PLANNING & ROUTINE

- Pre-Snapshot Power Management: High-ranking alliances coordinate "Power Caps" prior to snapshot dates, requiring players to hold off on massive troop promotions or troop training until the snapshot locks.

- Diplomatic Coalition Building: King leadership contacts potential alliance kingdoms weeks before KvK drops to form 2-kingdom or 3-kingdom coalitions (Camps) to avoid getting double-teamed on Day 1.

- Migration Target Filtering: Manage incoming target migrations to ensure your kingdom does not accidentally cross the power threshold into a higher Seed Tier right before matchmaking closes.

- Dead Troops and Activity Metrics: System matchmaking algorithms factor historical KvK activity (such as past dead troop counts, Kill Points, and alliance stars) alongside raw power to prevent high-performing kingdoms from seal-clubbing lower seeds.

- Zeroing Inactive Tops: Kingdom leadership systematically zeroes or forces migration on inactive high-power "bloat" accounts that sit in the Top 300 without contributing to KvK wars.

- Title & Buff Synchronization: Pause kingdom-wide power pushes (like Kingdom Training Buffs or Duke titles) during snapshot week to keep seed ratings artificially controlled.

TIPS & TRICKS FOR FAST GROWTH

- Off-Season Troop Purging: Encourage high-power players to burn off excess low-tier troops or un-needed units during Pre-KvK or KvK end-phases to drop overall account bloat.

- Third-Party Scanning Tools: Alliance leadership uses kingdom scanner tools (such as RoKStats or community Discord scanners) to track the real-time top 300 power of neighboring kingdoms in their continent match pool.

- Camp Positioning: In Season of Conquest (SoC), form pre-made 3-kingdom teams to ensure guaranteed ally coordination across border passes.

CRITICAL MISTAKES TO AVOID

- Carrying Inactive Bloat: Carrying 100M+ power players who do not fight inflates your top 300 score, dragging your kingdom into Seed A against active war kingdoms while losing 10% of your operational army.

- Breaking Pre-KvK Diplomatic Pacts: Violating early non-aggression or coalition agreements before Pass 4 opens ruins kingdom reputation, guaranteeing a 3v1 or 7v1 gang-up in future KvK seasons.

- Ignoring Continental Power Creep: Failing to monitor the top 300 stats of the 40 to 60 kingdoms in your migration region leaves leadership blind to sudden seed shifts caused by incoming whale migrations.

guides.title: The Ultimate F2P Guide
guides.summary: This essential Rise of Kingdoms guide provides a strategic, burnout-free roadmap for Free-to-Play (F2P) players. It covers critical tactics for long-term account health, from maximizing Action Points via barbarian chaining to smart alliance networking and disciplined resource investment, ensuring peak competitiveness for KvK.
guides.author: benjamin.rok
guides.content_markdown:
The Ultimate F2P Guide

Made by: peanut (benjamin.rok)

The start of an F2P account:

- 
choose china as your starting civilization for the 5% building time boost. With this, then you get the best epic commander which can be an Infantry march or cavalry march.

- 
make sure you are in a great project that knows what they are doing. Projects are the core of the early game which forms great players. I would suggest joining the restart community on discord which has all the active projects 24/7.

- 
Make sure to try and be in top 1-3 alliances, they are usually the most organized and best alliances in the kingdom. They are crucial for your development when it comes to gaining gold chests from spenders.

- 
focus on one account at once, many players try to have more than one account which is killing them slowly and makes them quit, rather focus on one main account that 2. Even with farm accounts, then it’s more worth it to focus on your main than farm accounts.

Make a plan:

- Focus on one troop type, it is important for kvk 1, then you will with a 99% chance only have 1 march to run with in the field, that is why focusing on 1 troop type is important rather than focusing on 2 and having half the troops for each march. 

- 
will you have farm accounts? Or will that be too time consuming? Farm accounts are always great, but it is important to know when enough accounts is enough. Many people end up wanting many farm accounts, and then they end up not being able to handle it and quit. Rok is about fun while being strategic, use your time well and not by draining yourself. 

- 
A plan should never be focused on what you need to do every single day in the game. Instead, it should focus on creating a healthy balance between real life and Rise of Kingdoms. I always recommend enjoying one main account rather than trying to manage several. As an F2P player, the game can become extremely time-consuming, and that's one of its biggest downsides. Without a proper balance, it can quickly start to feel more like a job than a game. By creating a stable routine that gives both your real life and RoK the time they deserve, you'll enjoy the game much more, avoid burnout, and still make steady progress toward building a strong account.

Efficiency:

F2P’s biggest problem is how much time you have to spend on playing and grinding. That is why we need a way to stay as efficient as possible. 

- 
Chaining: the most efficient way to gain free resources, speedups and arrows to upgrade  your watchtower. You get a 1500 ap bar that passively grows up to 1500 each day, you also get 500 free ap each day. That is why you should either always chain or always join barb forts. Cause barb forts are another important part of growing your account.   

- 
Barb forts: barb forts give you books of the covenant to upgrade you castle, the castle is needed to gain T5 which is everyones goal of unlocking. 

- 
Scouting: you need to send you scouts daily to unlock the fog and quickly gain the resources from caves and villages. (note: do not use the instant clear fog maps, as they give 5 minutes per map which usually ends up being up to 12 hours of speedups)

- 
Upgrade consistently, if buildings are upgrading with 2 hours left and you need to go to bed, then speed it up and upgrade a new building so it builds overnight. That is how efficiency is key for F2P, you could love 6 hours of building time while sleeping if you don’t speed up when it’s needed.

- 
Send out gatherers when you don’t have AP left. 

Tips and tricks:

- instead of not chaining for a day, then rather send your marches to barb forts, it will take you 10 seconds to send out marches to a rally and then you can log off.

- focus on upgrading one commander at a time, when it comes to commander in f2p, then you cannot spread power like spenders, you need to use it on your commanders you focus on. (max 5 commanders because of the path of vengeance. 

- always send out gatherers if your ap bar is low, make time efficient and focus on never having any march home ever.

- 
invest into gathering commanders, minimum level 27 for them to get the extra bonus when they have gathered a full node. 

- 
create farm accounts if you won’t burn out from having them and controlling them. They are another key to having a very successful account.

- 
save action points. There is a lot of talk about using your free daily ap, but never use your ap unless it is for lohar necklaces or for pre kvk marauders, they are the most worth it thing to save up for. 

Huge mistakes to avoid:

- 
Do not spend speedups on random events or just random times when you don’t get good rewards for it. 

- 
Never keep the ap bar max, it needs to be drained of ap each second. Otherwise you will lose valuable resources for your account.

- 
Do not invest gold sculptures into gold key commanders, this is the biggest mistake for any player, even spenders, cause it is a waste of sculptures when you can use them on soc commanders when you are finished with kvk 2. Soc commanders are way more crucial than any other commander. 

- 
Do not invest into commanders that are focused on being rally leader or garrison leader. Focus on having an account for open field which is the most important part of your account. 

- 
Know what equipment to invest into, there is a lot of different equipment, but there are 3 main equipment sets to focus on, with 3 support sets you can also choose. 

- 
Do not spend gems on anything except VIP. VIP is crucial to always get as high of a level possible to get a passive income of gold heads. You can of course spend on for example the wheel of fortune with YSG being the commander focus point.

guides.title: City Hall Upgrade Guide
guides.summary: City Hall is the most important building in Rise of Kingdoms and the foundation for everything else. This guide covers upgrade requirements for every level, what each level unlocks, and why levels 17 and 25 are the key milestones.
guides.author: Ronin Victory
guides.content_markdown:
City Hall Upgrade Guide

The most important building in Rise of Kingdoms is City Hall, which serves as the foundation for all other structures. Upgrades and requirements for City Hall are high; you must upgrade other buildings before you can upgrade your City Hall. You will gain many benefits by upgrading it, so try to do so as soon as possible.

City Hall is the only building in RoK that you must construct as soon as possible because it unlocks many benefits.

After you have upgraded your City Hall to level 25, you can begin to focus on the castle and academy in order to research your tier 5 troops more quickly. You can also play Rise of Kingdoms on PC for a more immersive experience.

To get to level 25, you must use universal speedups on City Hall, but you should not use them on the other buildings.

Do not be concerned if you upgraded your CH to level 25 without purchasing a growth bundle. You will be able to purchase it later and receive all rewards from level 1 to level 25.

Why you should upgrade your City Hall:

There are numerous reasons why you should upgrade the City Hall, but the most important is that you will gain power and progress faster in Rise of Kingdoms. Other advantages include:

- 
Unlocks technology research.

- 
More dispatches: the more troops you can send out, the faster you can farm, destroy barbarians, and obtain Tier 5 units.

- 
Troop capacity: this enables you to send more troops with your commanders, allowing you to gather more, destroy barbarians faster, fight, and so on.

- 
Hospital capacity: it will allow you to upgrade your hospital so you do not lose troops.

- 
Events: some events, such as Kingdom vs. Kingdom, require you to have City Hall on level 17 to participate.

Rewards for Era Breakthrough City Hall upgrades:

City Hall level 17

City Hall level 17 is significant in Rise of Kingdoms for two reasons. The first is that you unlock the fourth dispatch unit, which is useful for gathering faster on your main account. Level 17 is also the point where you stop upgrading your farm account; for farm accounts, going above City Hall level 17 is not worth it.

The second reason is that most Kingdom vs. Kingdom events require City Hall level 17. You will not be able to teleport to the Kingdom vs. Kingdom map if your account is below level 17.

You can reach City Hall level 17 in 15 days if you join an active alliance with nice buffs.

Era Breakthrough

Era Breakthrough will give you a nice boost with rewards. It is a permanent event in Rise of Kingdoms that every player will have. To get even more rewards, you can also use ROK codes.

City Hall is the only building in RoK that you must construct as soon as possible because it unlocks many benefits.

After you have upgraded your City Hall to level 25, you can begin to focus on the castle and academy in order to research your tier 5 troops more quickly. You can also play Rise of Kingdoms on PC for a more immersive experience.

To get to level 25, you must use universal speedups on City Hall, but you should not use them on the other buildings.

Do not be concerned if you upgraded your CH to level 25 without purchasing a growth bundle. You will be able to purchase it later and receive all rewards from level 1 to level 25.

Why you should upgrade your City Hall:

There are numerous reasons why you should upgrade the City Hall, but the most important is that you will gain power and progress faster in Rise of Kingdoms. Other advantages include:

  • Unlocks technology research.

  • More dispatches: the more troops you can send out, the faster you can farm, destroy barbarians, and obtain Tier 5 units.

  • Troop capacity: this enables you to send more troops with your commanders, allowing you to gather more, destroy barbarians faster, fight, and so on.

  • Hospital capacity: it will allow you to upgrade your hospital so you do not lose troops.

  • Events: some events, such as Kingdom vs. Kingdom, require you to have City Hall on level 17 to participate.

Rewards for Era Breakthrough City Hall upgrades:

City Hall level 17

City Hall level 17 is significant in Rise of Kingdoms for two reasons. The first is that you unlock the fourth dispatch unit, which is useful for gathering faster on your main account. Level 17 is also the point where you stop upgrading your farm account; for farm accounts, going above City Hall level 17 is not worth it.

The second reason is that most Kingdom vs. Kingdom events require City Hall level 17. You will not be able to teleport to the Kingdom vs. Kingdom map if your account is below level 17.

You can reach City Hall level 17 in 15 days if you join an active alliance with nice buffs.

Era Breakthrough

Era Breakthrough will give you a nice boost with rewards. It is a permanent event in Rise of Kingdoms that every player will have. To get even more rewards, you can also use ROK codes.
